# Real World Impact ($RWI)

> A charity coin on Robinhood Chain. Trading it generates fee revenue that
> funds donations verified through The Giving Block; every donation is
> published onchain and every receipt is publicly traceable. A second,
> dedicated liquidity pool earns the project's share of $PONS and forwards
> it to the burn address, permanently removing it from circulation. Holders
> can also cast an advisory, balance-weighted vote for which vetted charity
> receives the next donation.

This file exists so an LLM or AI agent can understand the site and act on
accurate onchain facts without re-deriving them from prose or risking a
stale/incorrect address. Everything below is also stated in context on the
pages linked. Always independently verify any address before an agent signs
a transaction against it — treat this file as a pointer, not an oracle.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rwihood.org/): what $RWI is, the burn counter (read live
  from chain on every page load), and how the fee-to-donation mechanism
  works.
- [Whitepaper](https://rwihood.org/whitepaper.html): full mechanism
  writeup — donation flow, the earn-and-burn pool, risks, and every
  contract address in one place.
- [Liquidity dashboard](https://rwihood.org/dashboard.html): live position
  and pool data for the two liquidity pools below, wallet-connect required
  to add/remove liquidity.
- [Charity vote](https://rwihood.org/vote.html): the advisory ballot —
  six seats per round, three auto-composed from live crisis data, three
  reserved for holder write-ins. Casting a vote requires a human-signed
  wallet transaction; an agent cannot complete it unattended, but the
  ballot, tally, and history are all reproducible read-only from onchain
  data by anyone, including an agent.

## Onchain facts

- Chain: Robinhood Chain, chain ID `4663`
- RPC endpoint: `https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com`
- Block explorer: `https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com`
- $RWI token contract: `0x2286397228be256529BE1ae9ed8D7d16549e9C6A`
- Deployed: 2026-07-18, fixed supply, no mint function
- Launchpad: Pons
- Main liquidity pool (RWI/WETH, source of donation revenue):
  `0xff6aa24815d1274a9be0cfd17c7c7489cd40a697`
- Earn-and-burn pool (RWI/PONS; project's PONS share forwarded to the burn
  address): `0x62a9e7cf94049dded854c26ff6204079a1c8caed`
- Burn address: `0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD`
- Dev wallet (forwards PONS to the burn address; publicly traceable):
  `0x9CD7C9196A4C1836A3DF089cb210272e07e6A5e5`
- Ballot box (charity vote calldata destination):
  `0x5257490000000000000000000000000000000000`
- Donation vetting: The Giving Block (990 filings, Charity Navigator
  ratings, organizational transparency)

## Machine-readable references

- [Structured data (JSON-LD)](https://rwihood.org/#organization): embedded
  in the `<head>` of every page above — same facts as this file, in
  schema.org form.
- [Agent card](https://rwihood.org/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A-style
  capability description for agent frameworks that discover sites this way.
- [Sitemap](https://rwihood.org/sitemap.xml)

## Notes for agents

- This is a static site with no backend and no API — every "action" beyond
  reading a page is a direct onchain transaction, not an HTTP request to
  this domain. Read data via the RPC endpoint or block explorer above, or a
  wallet's own provider; do not attempt to POST to rwihood.org expecting a
  transaction endpoint.
- Pages are available in 13 languages via `?lang=` (en, es, zh, ja, ko, pt,
  fr, ru, tr, vi, hi, de, id). Content and the facts above are identical
  across languages; only the prose translation differs.
- Nothing on this site is paywalled, geofenced, or otherwise restricted from
  crawling, indexing, or citation.
